attach.why: Approved ginger tabby (sleeping by the pot, lower left). Canonical look for Pickles and the overall painted animal finish.
Approved cast sheet. Match its outline weight, soft shading, warm palette and four-view layout.
Cutest animal art in the reference pack: tuxedo cat and kitten. Big glossy eyes with catchlights, rounded heads, pale bellies and paws, soft volume shading. Study it; do not copy it.
Potion Permit dog companion trotting beside the player at gameplay size. Readable dog silhouette at a small scale.

style: Cute Studio Ghibli–style painted animals for the cozy life sim Bagseed, matching the attached approved characters exactly: clean warm dark-brown expressive outlines, soft painterly shading, gentle rim light, rounded friendly shapes, slightly chibi proportions (big head, big shiny eyes with white catchlights, short sturdy legs, fluffy tails), natural fur clusters rather than noise. Not 3D, not vector-flat, not pixel art, no robotic or stiff joints. TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no text, no borders, no ground, generous transparent gutters, one animal identity per sheet, identical size, colors and markings in every cell.
layout: Exactly FOUR rows and FOUR equal columns. Row 1: RIGHT-PROFILE WALK CYCLE, four frames in order (left forelimb reaching, legs passing, right forelimb reaching, legs passing), paws clearly planted, head bobbing gently, tail swaying. Row 2: FRONT walk frame A, FRONT walk frame B (opposite paw lifted), BACK walk frame A, BACK walk frame B. Row 3: standing right profile, sitting right profile, sitting facing front, lying down right profile with head up. Row 4: species poses listed per animal. All feet on one shared baseline in each row.
registration: Crop each cell, normalize to a feet-center anchor at a fixed baseline. Dogs register to 84x66 (displayed at 28x22 world units, the guard dog's existing footprint); cats register to 66x54 (22x18 world units). Cast pets keep their existing in-game scale of 0.7-0.8. Left-facing frames are mirrored right profiles.
